stories.text: Exit polls in Israel's general election show Benjamin Netanyahu and former military chief Gadi Eisenkot tied, with neither projected to win a majority.
John Healey's first Budget is expected to focus on cost of living support, particularly energy bills, along with announcements on devolution.
Flavio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, has arrived in the US hours after failing to hand over his passports, which Brazil cancelled.
The King begins a nine-day Caribbean tour of the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda, acknowledging past suffering as it opens.
Calmer weather follows the recent storms across the UK, but thick fog and mist could make driving dangerous for commuters this week.
Neil Young is suing the Trump campaign again for playing Rockin' in the Free World at a rally, after a similar lawsuit in 2020.
MPs warn that switching UK landlines to digital by January could leave remote areas unable to call for help in an emergency.
The Alexander brothers, formerly high-profile US real estate moguls, have each been sentenced to 30 years in prison in a sex trafficking case.
Passengers on the luxury cruise ship Villa Vie Odyssey are stranded in Cambodia after soaring fuel costs forced the voyage to be suspended.
Utah authorities used advanced DNA technology to link serial killer Ted Bundy to the murder of a teenage girl 52 years ago.
